reroll_token.effectText: 次のショップリロールはGoldコスト-1。

coupon_stamp.effectText: 次のItemまたはJester購入はGoldコスト-2。

two_pair_study.effectText: ショップで使うとTwo Pair成長+1。

triple_study.effectText: ショップで使うとTriple成長+1。

straight_study.effectText: ショップで使うとStraight成長+1。

flush_study.effectText: ショップで使うとFlush成長+1。

full_house_study.effectText: ショップで使うとFull House成長+1。

four_kind_study.effectText: ショップで使うとFour of a Kind成長+1。

straight_flush_study.effectText: ショップで使うとStraight Flush成長+1。

line_memory.effectText: Choose a scoring line. Its current hand rank gains growth +1.

line_polish.effectText: 次の確定の最終スコアがx1.25。

straight_oil.effectText: 次のRunライン確定は+40 Chips。

overlap_pin.effectText: 次の確定は重複ボーナス上限が少し上がる。

emergency_draw.effectText: 手札が空でデッキにタイルがあれば、今1枚引く。

ledger_clip.effectText: ショップ入場時に+1 Gold。

score_abacus.effectText: 各Stationの最初の確定は+30 Chips。

merchant_stamp.effectText: ショップ入場後、最初のリロールはGoldコスト-1。

safety_net.effectText: 各Stationで1回、run終了になる最初の戦闘ロックを防ぐ。

coin_funnel.effectText: 精算時、未使用ボード捨て1回ごとに報酬+1 Gold。

hand_funnel.effectText: 精算時、未使用手札捨て1回ごとに報酬+1 Gold。

echo_bell.effectText: 各Stationの2回目の確定に、1回目の確定スコアの10%を加える。

boss_trophy.effectText: Showdownクリア後、次のショップのJester候補+1。

thin_wallet.effectText: 3 Gold以下の時だけ使用可能。+5 Gold。

trade_ticket.effectText: Item候補だけをリロールする。

red_swatch.effectText: 次の確定で、赤タイル1枚ごとに得点 +10%。

blue_swatch.effectText: 次の確定で、青タイル1枚ごとに得点 +10%。

black_swatch.effectText: 次の確定で、黒タイル1枚ごとに得点 +10%。

yellow_swatch.effectText: 次の確定で、黄色タイル1枚ごとに得点 +10%。

rank_chalk.effectText: 次の確定で、同じ数字のタイル1枚ごとに+12 Chips。

deck_needle.effectText: デッキ上から3枚を見て1枚捨てる。

tile_polisher.effectText: 各Stationで最初に得点したタイルは+20 Chips。

slide_wax.effectText: 次のボード移動はスライドボーナス効果も発動する。

board_lift.effectText: 次のStation用にボード移動+1を予約。

undo_seal.effectText: 最後のボード移動を1回取り消す。

wide_grip.effectText: 各Station開始時、最大手札+1、ボード捨て-1。

grand_satchel.effectText: 各Station開始時、最大手札+2、手札捨て-1。

market_compass.effectText: ショップ入場時、Item/Jester候補のうち安い最初の候補を1 Gold割引。

minor_memory.effectText: Choose a scoring line. Its current hand rank gains growth +2, and that line scores -25% on this confirm.

cross_memory.effectText: Choose a scoring crossing line. Its current hand rank gains growth +1 and the line receives a cross memory marker.

thin_memory.effectText: Choose a 3-4 tile scoring line. Its current hand rank gains growth +1, and that line scores -10% on this confirm.

boss_memory.effectText: During a boss battle, choose a scoring line. Its current hand rank gains growth +2.

keystone_copy.effectText: Choose any board line. Add its center tile to your deck.

edge_copy.effectText: Choose an endpoint tile from any board line. Add a copy to your deck.

rank_echo.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a random-color tile with the same number to your deck.

color_echo.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a random-number tile with the same color to your deck.

scarce_copy.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a copy to your deck.

sealed_copy.effectText: Choose a sealed or enhanced tile from any board line. Add a copy to your deck.

line_seal_stamp.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a line seal; when scored, it grants chip bonus.

growth_seal.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a growth seal; when scored, the hand rank grows +1.

gold_seal_stamp.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a gold seal; when scored, gain Gold +1.

echo_seal.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add an echo seal; overlapping scoring gains a bonus.

anchor_seal.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add an anchor seal; moved scoring gains a bonus.

risk_seal.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Add a crack seal; it gives a large score bonus and later removal risk.

rank_concord.effectText: Choose a board line with 3+ tiles. This confirm treats it as Three of a Kind.

step_rite.effectText: Choose a board line with 3+ tiles. This confirm treats it as Straight.

color_concord.effectText: Choose a board line with 3+ tiles. This confirm treats it as Flush.

off_color_rite.effectText: Choose a board line with 3+ tiles. This confirm treats it as Full House.

wild_thread.effectText: Choose a board line with 3+ tiles. This confirm treats it as Four of a Kind.

number_mask.effectText: Choose a board line with 3+ tiles. This confirm treats it as Five of a Kind.

line_pruner.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Mark a matching deck tile for removal and gain Gold +2.

trim_color.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Mark a same-color deck tile for removal.

trim_rank.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Mark a same-number deck tile for removal.

deadwood_burn.effectText: Choose any board line. Clear its board tiles and gain Gold +3.

sacrifice_line.effectText: Choose any board line. Clear it, copy up to two tiles to your deck, and mark one copied tile for removal.

cross_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring crossing line. This confirm gives that line score +25%.

corner_rite.effectText: Choose a board line containing a corner. Copy one endpoint tile to your deck.

center_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring line containing the center. Its current hand rank gains growth +1.

diagonal_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring diagonal line. This confirm gives that line score +35%.

bridge_rite.effectText: Choose a shared crossing tile. Add a bridge marker; future dual-line scoring gains Gold.

ritual_coupon.effectText: The next item purchase costs 2 less Gold.

ritual_lens.effectText: Reroll current item offers and favor ritual choices.

line_pack_ticket.effectText: Add one extra item offer slot in the next Market.

seal_vendor.effectText: The next item purchase costs 1 less Gold.

prune_vendor.effectText: The next item purchase costs 1 less Gold.
